row.body: A cloudy water bottle and an empty sample jar share a strip of twine. Pale spray dust remains beneath both, inside the cupboard.
row.title: Two jars from the school garden

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.

row.body: The roll book is open to an ordinary lesson. A pencil note on its back records a later head count, including pupils whose names are absent from the official list.
row.title: Attendance from the wrong day

sidecar.gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
sidecar.rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
